name: naffo-marketplace
description: Official Claude Code plugins and skills for the Naffo ERP platform — dairy procurement, accounting, sales, inventory, demand forecasting, production planning, optimization, business analytics, and India GST compliance. Includes reusable customer forms and optional quotation handoffs.

plugins.name: naffo
plugins.description: Work with Naffo ERP from Claude Code — operational management (invoices, payments, stock, dairy, CRM, reports), business planning (demand forecasting, production planning, inventory optimization, stock transfers), six analytics skills (month-end close, monthly digest, client profitability, revenue concentration, seasonal patterns, cash runway), and an India GST layer (GSTR mapping, ITC reconciliation, April–March FY), and company priorities / feedback loops. Includes Forms & Requests, customer brief analysis and optional quotation/customer/lead/project connections.
